graph.method: function-level static graph over the exact candidate DSOs: nm-defined functions; objdump direct call edges; and an intraprocedural abstract interpreter that resolves indirect control transfers from relocations (GOT/PLT), immutable dispatch tables, relative jump tables, literal callback stores, field-offset stores in reachable code, and an interprocedural argument summary.  A site that cannot be resolved keeps its evidence class; only a site with no class admits the global address-taken union
graph.upper_bound_rule: direct edges + the resolver's per-site target sets + the residual class (functions address-materialised in reachable code, consumer-imported symbols, values stored into object fields by reachable code, and values passed at unresolved call sites); the global address-taken union is admitted only for an unclassified site, and any such site is listed in precision.unclassified_reachable_sites

reachable_export_symbols.note: candidate DSO exports reached by the graph, including the 12 consumer imports; the consumer-imported set is in symbol_evidence

special_edges.provider_narrowing: the consumer imports no provider installation/selection symbol and no dynamic name lookup, and the reachable set contains 0 provider/engine selection symbol(s); provider dispatch is therefore limited to built-in providers whose tables are reached through the resolver, not to a dynamically registered provider
special_edges.note: each listed class was checked against the reachable set of the exact candidate code; an empty list is an observed absence on this closure, not an assumption.  A reachable dynamic name lookup would be an unmodelled edge class because the static graph cannot resolve names

unmapped_crate_functions.note: crate-namespace functions with no module-path mapping; they are a coverage limit of the demangler, not a claim of unreachability

observed_trace.note: no observed execution trace was supplied; the closure is the static upper bound alone

limits: inlined callees have no out-of-line function node; their code is attributed to the caller, so a source file whose only contribution is inlined has no node of its own
the resolver is an over-approximation: an unresolved site is admitted at its evidence class, and every unclassified site is listed rather than silently dropped
a dynamic trace proves execution, not unreachability, and never narrowed this graph
function-level reachability is not a proof that a site is safe; it bounds which obligations apply

precision.purpose: replace the global address-taken collapse with per-site, evidence-bound target sets; every residual site states why it remains unresolved

got_or_table.invariant: the slot's value is fixed by the dynamic loader and the slot lies in .got/.got.plt/.data.rel.ro/.rodata, which are immutable after relocation; a writable .data/.bss slot is used only with the union of all stores performed by reachable code

table.mechanism: static dispatch/vtable table read with a known base
table.invariant: the base address is a link-time constant (lea or a relocated pointer), so every entry is a relocation-resolved function address; an unfilled or open entry makes the site unresolved

switch.evidence: 4-byte relative entries from a known .rodata base
switch.invariant: the table base is a link-time constant and every entry is decoded; targets that are function starts are admitted, intra-function targets add no new node

field.evidence: stores to that offset by reachable code, consumer-imported values and the return values of consumer-imported constructors, and code-materialised addresses when the field is open
field.invariant: a function value installed in a reachable object at a known offset is either written by reachable code (store summary), supplied by the consumer (its imported symbols and their returns, since the artefact has no dynamic name lookup), or address-materialised in reachable code; an open field adds the code-materialised set

materialised.mechanism: direct call through a value with no static table provenance
materialised.evidence: address-of materialisations in reachable code + consumer imports
materialised.invariant: after GOT/table/switch/field resolution, a remaining value can only be an address taken in reachable code or a value supplied by the consumer; a site that cannot be assigned even this class is listed as unclassified and admits the global union

precision.invariants_summary: Each class is narrowed only by evidence that fixes the possible values at the site.  A trace never narrows anything.  Functions that are not observed remain reachable if any bound admits them.  The residual class is a bound, not a claim that every listed function is called.
precision.settled: the only reachable unresolved sites are field- or materialised-class sites; no unclassified site is reachable
